en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick and stucco institutional building on a cobblestone street. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Northern European, with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, ornate central gable above the main entrance, and segmental‑arched ground‑floor windows. A tall cast‑iron streetlamp stands in front, and a long wing or adjoining complex extends to the right.
